title: Domain availability / RDAP batch input
description: Paste domains (or URLs — the host is extracted). For each name the Actor returns available|registered|unknown using RDAP first, then optional DNS and WHOIS fallbacks. Positioning: batch availability verdicts for inventory — not spam or lead-gen.

domains.title: Domains
domains.description: One or more domains. Accepts plain strings (`example.com`), `{"domain": "..."}` objects, or `{"url": "https://..."}` (host is used). Deduplicated, order preserved.

maxDomains.title: Max domains
maxDomains.description: Stop after checking this many unique domains (0 = no limit). Also caps cost.

useRdap.title: Use RDAP
useRdap.description: Query public RDAP (preferred). NotFound → available; object found → registered.

useDns.title: Use DNS fallback
useDns.description: If RDAP is inconclusive, use DNS: NXDOMAIN → available; NS/A answers → registered.

useWhois.title: Use WHOIS fallback
useWhois.description: If RDAP/DNS are inconclusive, query public WHOIS as a last resort.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Parallel domain checks. Keep moderate (2–8) to stay polite to public RDAP/WHOIS.

queryDelayMs.title: Min delay between queries (ms)
queryDelayMs.description: Global minimum milliseconds between starting RDAP/WHOIS queries. 0 = no extra delay.

requestTimeoutSecs.title: Per-domain timeout (seconds)
requestTimeoutSecs.description: Timeout budget for RDAP + DNS + WHOIS attempts on one domain.

writeMarkdownTable.title: Write Markdown table (KV)
writeMarkdownTable.description: Also write a simple Markdown table to key-value store record TABLE.md.

chargeFailedDomains.title: Charge unknown/failed domains
chargeFailedDomains.description: When off (default), only available|registered verdicts are charged. Unknown/error rows are saved free. When on, every attempted domain is charged once.
